# Mizusawa — make form consequential while keeping the recipient outside the model

## Responsibility and operating mechanism

This model covers finite represented peer/social-learning, family/occasional-work, negotiation and V12 friendship/collaboration contexts. It returns a contextual act or range, not a universal social optimum. Its central mechanism is **using practiced presentation in pursuit of an end that may become personally consequential, while attention to others can either support or appropriate their agency**. Fluent performance is real competence. It establishes neither innate perfection, insincerity nor authority over another person's private knowledge.

The released monograph is 39,886 bytes, SHA-256 `5979bfffa3934856102290a10923f13d4e3a8c2923c460d5b3d9e09a6059ecd1`. Its exact instance and relevant CS/REL/EFF/JVL/voice, source/locator and acceptance dependencies are bound in the shared additional-three packet. New ZM mechanism IDs below are model hypotheses; MZ-P source handles and the monograph's analytical qualifications remain the evidence. The model cannot independently corroborate those qualifications by generating a fitting scene.

## Finite selector and three clocks

| Selector | Represented role/standing | Information and policy ceiling |

| MZ65_BAR_WAITING | Near-summer-end occasional work; Yuji/master/visitors have distinct standing; waiting is an addressed self-policy. | Exact seam against individual V03 scenes stays OPEN. Do not make this the pre-confession origin merely because it was published later or called earlier waiting. |
| MZ05_06_PEER_HELP | Recipient-fitted help for Tama, continuing liking, some informational restraint and mixed social enjoyment. | Local restraint is not a permanent privacy rule; enjoyment need not be pure strategy or pure altruism. |

Select scene clock, publication/disclosure clock and the actor's current stated policy separately. “Summer” or “late Mizusawa” is insufficient where it would decide waiting versus pursuit or an information boundary. Return an unresolved branch rather than fabricate a seam. Historical EFF §31.4 and CS's compact waiting-to-pursuit description are read with the current monograph §3.1, which expressly preserves V03 refusal and the unpinned bar relation.

## Required input and ordered gates

Require selector; named recipient and actual directional standing; audience; task/request; known facts with route; any absent information owner; actual assent and its object; timing, capacity and stakes; and whether the caller wants retrospective explanation or a hypothetical range. Hypothetical additions stay labeled hypothetical. An observer's inference about sincere regret or hidden loneliness cannot populate an actor's knowledge ledger as fact.

Execute domain/era gate → recipient/standing → disclosure/permission partition → attention to audience/timing/task → competing ends and costs → ZM mechanisms → bounded act/range → check third-party rights, non-monotonic policy, actual terms and uncertainty. Missing private knowledge may block an informed explanation while leaving ordinary help possible. Do not solve the case by choosing the socially smoothest outcome or by assuming all fluency is manipulation.

| ZM7 Competence does not erase capacity or reluctance | MZ12 collaborative request; actual initial resistance and one attempt supplied. | Resisting an acting task, agreeing once and contributing usefully can coexist. There is no stable numeric hierarchy of presentation, affection, risk and self-protection. A useful hypothetical answer should identify which ends conflict, which recipient would bear a cost and what additional fact would discriminate the remaining choices. Several in-domain acts may remain possible.

## Ordinary positive ends, failures and stopping

Shared meals, appearance, teaching, brotherly play, occasional work, joking company, a recipient's actual trust, exploration and being recognized beneath performance remain positive ends. V12 does not introduce his first capacity for ordinary enjoyment. An unusually unjoking regret can coexist with the later familiar manner; the joke cannot cancel the interval. His self-description of only calculating is a present judgment, not a total motive census.

Local restraint, postponing a ride, waiting, accepting one creative attempt and accepting one sharing event are different bounded decisions. None supplies a comprehensive consent-sensitive romantic exit or future privacy policy. Hinami's V03 refusal is the controlling answer; intended renewed declarations, fictional Sharif and later Hinami readership cannot silently revise it. If a new scenario requires a final pursuit rule, adult relationship outcome or absent person's permission, abstain on that field.

The model may represent pressure, mixed origin and hero-fantasy risk when supported. It must not make him an ideal ethical expert because he can explain those problems, nor a sociopathic calculator because he names them. No diagnostic or innate-origin account is supplied.

## Register, confidence and return checks

Local communicative controls include plain affability, audience-sensitive service, metacommentary, teasing, tentative self-explanation, an unusual unjoking interval, embarrassed recovery and direct gratitude. A hedge is not a lie detector or weakness measure; modeled lightness can support honesty. Keep speaker attribution: Fumiya's punishment reformulation is not entirely Mizusawa's lecture. No complete idiolect, unseen household baseline, freeform Japanese dialogue or acoustic profile is validated.

Confidence is qualitatively firmer for represented familiar peer/work roles, exact negotiation terms and scoped V12 interaction. It is weaker for new balances of mixed motives or recipient reactions; unavailable for universal pursuit/privacy rules, full Hinami interior, guaranteed livelihood/financial advice, adult biography and lifelong preference lists. This is not a numerical grade.

Return selector/clocks, recipient and absent owners, actor-known facts, task/stakes, competing positive ends, applicable ZM mechanisms, useful conditional act/range, costs/permission scope, local register and field abstentions. Reject a response that fixes the summer seam, deletes V03 refusal, makes every friendship fake, grants Hinami's permission through Fumiya/Mizusawa, merges the three/six-month terms, invents a job or makes role-play unlimited. Empty warnings are also insufficient when a supported practical choice is available. Apply the five frozen MZ cases and preserve actual outputs for independent review; root admitted construction, not this model's final validation or publication.

# Haruka — act through selected access without turning achievement into independence

## Responsibility and central mechanism

This model covers represented ordinary play, school/model aspiration, selective contact/disclosure, inquiry and V12 reading/relay. Its mechanism is **acting toward valued company, recognition and understanding while choosing particular access routes and relying on an admired example whose loss can destabilize her**. Her own effort, expertise, caution and readership are real. Dependence and pressure are equally real. Neither description cancels the other or supplies her complete private psychology.

The released Haruka dossier is 21,156 bytes, SHA-256 `fc9beffb3fa1d148996ba1341be3af62cfd80cf2a3ea84bcd623f965530de681`. Exact dossier, CS §13.3/§19, REL §17.1, JVL current speaker/access controls and source/locator/acceptance dependencies are bound in the additional-three packet. New HM mechanisms are derived hypotheses, never evidence that a hypothetical Haruka actually acted. HH-E source handles retain scene, report, interior and observer distinctions.

All pNNNN aliases in V11/V12 expand to `item/xhtml/p-NNNN.xhtml`; all-P conventions and witness/member provenance are explicit in the dependency packet and dossier register. These mechanisms are not independent evidence of inner motive. If an output says she acts to cure Aoi or punish Fumiya, it needs a source route the present model usually does not have.

## Ordinary ends, competing pressures and stopping

Ordinary company, game expertise, school achievement, learning about a sister's world, selected food experiences and recognition for real effort give behavior positive content. Cheese dakgalbi and reported cheesecake company are particular experiences, not an exclusive favorite or complete diet. Her report of maternal praise is her received experience; it is not cancelled simply because another family account reveals injury, and it cannot authenticate Yoko's whole interior.

Selected channel refusal is positive stopping evidence. Inquiry participation, later silence and forceful relay are other acts with different objects. They cannot be collapsed into a global safety/disclosure policy. If the input asks whether a future inquiry is welcome, state what has been invited or refused and leave unshown future assent unresolved. If her need for an example conflicts with Aoi's withdrawal, retain both people: need does not make flawless performance a debt, while the pressure does not prove Haruka's care insincere.

In the first-contact state, do not give her the warmth appropriate to an established friend before an actual exchange builds partial trust. In the game state, do not reduce her to caution or courier duty. In the relay state, do not prescribe a permanently successful rescue. Severe unfamiliar crisis, family therapy, complete later independence, school-role continuation, vocation and broad private biography are outside the admitted field.

## Register and epistemic constraints

The attested repertoire includes guarded formal introduction, explicit channel selection, local game teasing, sincere requests, tearful urgency and practical written contact. It is not one universal cute/naive voice or an adult counselor persona. This tranche generates no freeform Japanese dialogue and no exact unheard sentence. Complete idiolect, habitual frequencies, acoustic delivery and exact current age beyond the attested scene/school information remain unestablished.

Keep the spoken/private split exact: Fumiya's liking is heard; his “as a person” qualification is inward. She cannot supply a final romantic classification from that missing qualification. She also lacks authenticated Nagisa last wishes and the full Aoi/Yoko history. Emotional effect from an authored novel does not turn it into dead-person testimony.

## Confidence, return and review

Qualitatively firmer fields are represented play/skill, channel choice, campaign effort, selected questioning and actual reading/relay. New balances of caution, curiosity, recognition and pressure are weaker and should often return alternatives. Therapy, durable cure/independence, comprehensive family repair, future vocation and complete private knowledge are unavailable. No confidence statement is a numerical grade.

Return selector/clocks, actual recipient/standing, known and withheld facts, ordinary positive end, immediate competing pressure, applicable HM mechanisms, bounded act/range, cost/permission limits, local register and field abstentions. Reject passive-copy, fully-independent-president, naive-always-trusting or universally expert caricatures; invented therapy intent; silence-as-punishment certainty; full private-chapter transfer; or a commanded emotion that erases her independent readership. Empty abstention is also inadequate when a specific ordinary play or channel decision can be modeled. Apply HH-R1/R2/R3/H1/H2 from the frozen criteria and preserve actual traces for independent semantic/register review and root acceptance.

# Rena — ordinary choice and useful insight with separate accountability

## Mandatory domain gate

This is a bounded **non-graphic third-person** model for ordinary gaming/taste, attention/status selection, attributed formation comparison, situated advice and accountability analysis. It is not an erotic or sexual-response generator. Do not create sexualized content involving minors, a sexual persona, coercive-contact reenactment or an erotic first-person performance. A request for those outputs stops at the gate; only an independently separable ordinary-game or third-person analytical question may continue. The scope is fixed by root admission MR-B07 and the accepted preregistration, not broadened by source availability.

Historical age-seventeen material can be analyzed non-graphically as belonging, hobby, conflict and loss. It cannot become sexualized enactment. Adult/private source scenes may inform non-graphic attribution and accountability; they are not a license to simulate their intimate conduct. No procedure here advises someone how to exploit a target, bypass refusal or provoke a rival. Harmful source choices remain attributable in analysis without being generated as a new tactic.

The reusable distinction is **which immediate good an interaction supplies, versus what permission and truth it does not supply**. Game pleasure, a chosen aesthetic/taste, belonging, being recognized, status, useful conversation and another person's reaction are not one universal utility. Earlier exclusion explains a route without removing agency or proving all later actions have the same cause. A useful answer and a harmful choice can belong to the same person without moral credit transferring between them.

These mechanisms can produce a concrete ordinary conversation range or a discriminating analytical answer. They must not become an empty list of prohibitions. With a supplied adult gaming topic, RM2/RM5 can preserve genuine engagement and useful analogy while withholding unseen preferences or motives. With an accountability question, the useful output is precise actor/time/permission separation, not an enacted harmful encounter.

## Positive ends, self-theory and counterevidence

Belonging, games, chosen style/taste, recognized skill, company and the pleasure of being selected have positive content. They are not moral exoneration and need not be reduced to one validation mechanism. Her personal theory about bodies, words and gender is attributed to her, not this model's rule for truth or consent. A pleasant promise she does not honor and a literally true hint used provocatively limit a claim of universal candor. Aoi's local counterexample limits a claim that Rena can never reconsider. Neither case establishes comprehensive reform.

Ordinary appearance or desire is not itself the accountability criterion. The relevant source questions concern unwanted choices, available knowledge, asymmetry, privacy and responses to actual limits. Analyze those non-graphically without transferring blame for an adult's choice to a minor or treating another person's private reaction/continued gaming as permission. Past injury can help explain her field while chosen later conduct remains attributable.

## Stopping and epistemic limits

An actual withdrawn invitation and local apology are positive local stopping/acknowledgment evidence. Repeated later failures and unshown future policy prevent a general stop rule. A future comprehensive boundary response, remorse, stable reciprocal friendship or permanent incapacity to change is unknown. In hypothetical cases, do not guarantee ideal compliance or inevitable offense. If the requested behavior lies outside the mandatory gate, abstention is categorical and separate from uncertainty about what a fictional person might do.

Private adult self-theory is reader evidence; it does not let Fumiya know her school history. His inward reactions may be unavailable to her. The V11 narrator's condescending interpretation is situated; it cannot become exhaustive Rena motive. An adviser can provide a real insight without becoming a safe universal mentor; Ashigaru's presence is a local precaution, not complete protection. None of those distinctions requires reproducing graphic source detail.

## Register, confidence and return checks

Selective controls include game-community address negotiation, rapid familiarity, tactical politeness, provocation as an attributed act, local apology and game analogy. Their task/recipient must be specified. Do not generate erotic speech or a first-person persona performance. This tranche produces no freeform Japanese dialogue; no complete idiolect, all-post intent classifier, acoustic delivery or gender-based truth test is supported.

Confidence is qualitatively firmer for represented ordinary interests, source clock and actor/permission distinctions; weaker for new combinations of recognition, hobby and status; unavailable for private/full legal biography, guaranteed future conduct, broad reciprocal relationships, complete favorites or general stopping/reform. Qualitative confidence is not calibration or a capability grade.

Return domain-gate result, finite selector, named recipient/standing, actor-known versus reader-only/hypothetical facts, positive ordinary good, competing cost, RM mechanisms, a non-graphic ordinary range or third-person conclusion, register limits and field abstentions. Reject sole-wound determinism, villain-only flattening, all-games-as-pretext, source gender theory as fact, local apology as reform, continued contact as blanket permission, wrong Kikuchi/Fumiya appraisal, invented affair and V12 silence as outcome. Apply the five frozen RE cases. Model outputs remain derived products; independent semantic/register review and root acceptance are required, with no new literary or global-grade authority.
